_about: The OLD stack's pixels per case, recorded at SW1 before it was deleted, from the pixel parity layer (browser/pixels.test.ts at 67de7853): per view/section@zoom/theme (@2x for DPR 2), each canvas as [old hash, next hash, pixels differing by more than the layer's tolerance]. A hash is the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the canvas's RGBA bytes, exact: Skia's output depends on the machine, Chrome and fonts (below), so compare hashes only on the same setup and use the counts otherwise. The next hash is the next stack's at the switch (a hash that differs with count 0 differs by less than the tolerance), the baseline for later changes. Host 1000 x 420 CSS px, fixture fonts, skin tokens set on it, manual clock.
